verdict.rationale: Zoom's first-party developer portal publishes an llms.txt that links a machine-readable API Catalog at /.well-known/api-catalog.json, which suggests machine-discoverable API descriptions. The Scribe docs list REST endpoints such as the vocabulary asset routes, but only as prose. Nothing in the pack shows a downloadable OpenAPI (or equivalent) spec that covers the Scribe API itself. Missing for 10: confirmed OpenAPI/spec file for Scribe endpoints, evidence that the API catalog links to Scribe specs, coverage of WebSocket/Live mode in a machine-readable spec, independent corroboration.
